o1: Predicted to enable protein phosphatase regulator activity and protein phosphatase activator activity. Involved in P granule assembly and sarcomere organization. Predicted to be part of protein phosphatase type 2A complex. Predicted to be active in cytosol and nucleus. Is located in the M line and dense body. Is expressed in body-wall muscle; anal depressor muscle; intestine; nervous system; reproductive system; and tail. Interacts with UNC-89. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal dominant intellectual developmental disorder 35. Orthologous to several human genes including PPP2R5D (protein phosphatase 2 regulatory subunit B'delta).
